provenance: Authored synthetic Go/JavaScript expansion, 2026-11-01. Closed-world relevance labels fixed before either binary is measured. Exercises pointer receivers, duplicate methods, cross-file calls, async ES modules, aliased imports, arrow helpers, literal reads and compound requests. Not captured real-user queries or independently labelled effectiveness.

memories.title: Envelope field agreement
memories.body: Downstream readers require the original field order in serialized notices.

memories.title: Pending notice lifetime
memories.body: The receiver expires a pending notice after half a minute. Longer waits lose the notice.

memories.title: Sender shutdown contract
memories.body: Repeated shutdown must be harmless for all operations on this sender.

memories.title: Preview display agreement
memories.body: Preview consumers require a visible test prefix.

memories.title: Notice key diagnostics
memories.body: Record noticeKey calls for diagnostic sampling.

queries.question: Which constraints must a change to NoticeSender.send preserve?
queries.rationale: Preserve method, owner and transitively called policy constraints; exclude alternate sender and key diagnostics.

queries.question: Which constraints govern NoticeSender.send retry timing?
queries.rationale: Only the receiver lifetime governs pauses.

queries.question: Why does NoticeSender.send stop increasing the pause after thirty seconds?
queries.rationale: Half a minute and thirty seconds are equivalent; unrelated field order does not explain timing.

queries.question: What does noticeKey("sample") return?
queries.rationale: Source answers the explicit literal call; diagnostic policy is unrelated.

queries.question: What does pauseFor(2) return?
queries.rationale: Source computes the value; no design decision is requested.

queries.question: Which constraints must a change to PreviewSender.send preserve?
queries.rationale: The independently implemented preview method has its own contract.

queries.question: What is the sender shutdown contract?
queries.rationale: The exact contract title identifies the owner-wide lifecycle constraint.

queries.question: What encryption algorithm governs NoticeSender.send?
queries.rationale: Neither source nor decisions specify an encryption algorithm.

queries.question: Why does NoticeSender.send wait at most thirty seconds and preserve field order?
queries.rationale: Both policies explain the explicit topics; this control must not focus only on timing.
